                                      Resolution 2023-16
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
   RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR INSTALLATION OF NO PARKING SIGNS ON
                        DONNER RD.


   WHEREAS, the success of the Girdwood Brewing Company has created unintended consequences to the neighboring properties and
     roads; and

   WHEREAS, the volume of parking needed for the brewery is not always available within the parking lot provided for that purpose;
    and

   WHEREAS, because parking is not permitted on Alyeska highway, patrons of the brewery are parking without restriction along both
     sides of Donner Road, as it is nearest the street crossing to the brewery; and

   WHEREAS, Donner Road is not wide enough to safely accommodate pedestrians, vehicular traffic and on-street parking on both sides
    and enable the passing of emergency vehicles; and

   WHEREAS, without No Parking Signage, our police are unable to ticket and tow vehicles that park in ways that make it impossible
     for local traffic to pass safely; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Public Safety Advisory Committee has recommended that No Parking Signs be installed on Donner Road
     to limit parking to one side of the street by a unanimous vote at their regular meeting on September 12, 2023;

   THEREFORE, in accordance with AMC 9.30.080.A Parking on Narrow Streets, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors requests that No
    Parking Signage on permanent posts are placed on one side of Donner Road, to allow free and safe flow of traffic and emergency
     vehicle access.


   PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 4 in favor and 0 opposed this 18th day of September 2023.




   Amanda Sassi                                        Attest
   GBOS Police, Roads and Utilities Supervisor
